title: claim-basis-guard reads a hyphenated row id ending in a digit and R as an R-figure claim; add a lookbehind so a figure glued to a preceding letter or digit is not a claim
note: Found 2026-10-25 by manager 01MdQiC8. guards failed on PR #20145 because rows DESK-2/DESK-3 had titles citing the apply-path row id. Fix, validated locally then reverted (manager-scope-guard puts scripts/ and tests/ off-limits): in scripts/check_claim_basis.py _CLAIM_RE, prefix the R alternative with the lookbehind (?<![A-Za-z0-9]). Add 2 tests: a hyphenated row id passes, and a parenthesised minus-four-R claim still fails. The 19 tests passed and the --self-test passed with the change. Workaround on #20145: titles reworded.
